sourceEditorialReview.notes: Read all 36 move-specific explanations and all 21 serious candidate decisions. The review preserves likelihood versus posterior scope, explicit bare-theism and scriptural concessions, limited cognitive closure, fallible testimony, and individual causal history. No-tag reasons distinguish missing quantitative support, disputed assumptions, imperfect analogy, and failure to establish necessity from exact catalog defects. The post-hoc adaptation candidate remains open for anonymous adjudication: this reviewer treats the alternative psychological explanation as insufficient evidence of selective interpretation, while acknowledging unsupported discounting. No scores, excluded Q&A, or catalog quotas influence the result.
